newsitem.title: USA: Delta to announce jet contract at 1300 EST.
newsitem.headline: Delta to announce jet contract at 1300 EST.

text.p: Delta said it planned a news conference at 1300 EST/1800 GMT at Hartsfield Atlanta International Airport to announce a major new aircraft purchase.
The Wall Street Journal said in its electronic edition Thursday that Delta and Boeing Co are expected to announce a long-term pact Thursday whereby the airline would buy all its aircraft from Boeing.

Under the pact, expected to be worth billions of dollars, Delta would buy dozens of wide-body and narrow-body jetliners from Boeing and it agreed to make Boeing its exclusive aircraft source for "several decades," the paper said, citing sources familiar with the deal.
Boeing was not available for comment. Delta would not elaborate.
